78508-the-hand-of-power.title: Hand Of Power
78508-the-hand-of-power.creator: Edgar Wallace
78508-the-hand-of-power.description: A book by Edgar Wallace. e barren face of Dartmoor, that ancient desolation. The howl and shriek of it came to Betty Carew above the rattle and roar of the motor engine as the old car grunted and groaned up the steep hill.

arxiv-1903-01589.title: Albatross An Optimistic Consensus Algorithm April 16, 2024 Thanks: This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.
arxiv-1903-01589.creator: Pascal Berrang, Inês Cruz, Bruno França, Philipp von Styp-Rekowsky, Marvin Wissfeld
arxiv-1903-01589.description: Abstract The consensus protocol is a critical component of distributed ledgers and blockchains. Achieving consensus over a decentralized network poses challenges to transaction finality and performance. Currently, the highest-performing consensus algorithms are speculative BFT algorithms, which, however, compromise on the transaction finality guarantees offered by their non-speculative counterparts.

arxiv-2102-09325.title: Plateau transitions of spin pump and bulk-edge correspondence
arxiv-2102-09325.creator: Yoshihito Kuno, Yasuhiro Hatsugai
arxiv-2102-09325.description: Abstract Sequential plateau transitions of quantum spin chains ( S S =1,3/2,2 and 3) are demonstrated by a spin pump using dimerization and staggered magnetic field as synthetic dimensions. The bulk is characterized by the Chern number associated with the boundary twist and the pump protocol as a time.

arxiv-2104-12015.title: Klein’s ten planar dessins of degree 11 11 , and beyond
arxiv-2104-12015.creator: Gareth A. Jones, Alexander K. Zvonkin
arxiv-2104-12015.description: Abstract We reinterpret ideas in Klein’s paper on transformations of degree 11 11 from the modern point of view of dessins d’enfants, and extend his results by considering dessins of type ( 3 , 2 , p ) (3,2,p) and degree p p or p + 1 p+1 , where p p is prime.

arxiv-2308-05967.title: YOLOrtho: A Unified Framework for Teeth Enumeration and Dental Disease Detection
arxiv-2308-05967.creator: Shenxiao Mei, Chenglong Ma, Feihong Shen, Huikai Wu, Kaidi Shen
arxiv-2308-05967.description: Abstract Detecting dental diseases through panoramic X-rays images is a standard procedure for dentists. Normally, a dentist need to identify diseases and find the infected teeth. While numerous machine learning models adopting this two-step procedure have been developed, there has not been an end-to-end model that can identify teeth and their associated diseases at the same time.

arxiv-2402-19325.title: Do End-to-End Neural Diarization Attractors Need to Encode Speaker Characteristic Information?
arxiv-2402-19325.description: Abstract In this paper, we apply the variational information bottleneck approach to end-to-end neural diarization with encoder-decoder attractors (EEND-EDA). This allows us to investigate what information is essential for the model. EEND-EDA utilizes attractors, vector representations of speakers in a conversation. Our analysis shows that, attractors do not necessarily have to contain speaker characteristic information.

arxiv-2409-17830.title: Unsupervised Learning Based Multi-Scale Exposure Fusion
arxiv-2409-17830.creator: C. B. Zheng, S. Q. Wu, Z. G. Li
arxiv-2409-17830.description: Abstract Unsupervised learning based multi-scale exposure fusion (ULMEF) is efficient for fusing differently exposed low dynamic range (LDR) images into a higher quality LDR image for a high dynamic range (HDR) scene. Unlike supervised learning, loss functions play a crucial role in the ULMEF.

arxiv-2506-12260.title: Improving Speech Enhancement with Multi-Metric Supervision from Learned Quality Assessment
arxiv-2506-12260.creator: Wei Wang 1 , Wangyou Zhang 2 , Chenda Li 1 , Jaitong Shi 3 , Shinji Watanabe 3 , Yanmin Qian 1
arxiv-2506-12260.description: Abstract Speech quality assessment (SQA) aims to predict the perceived quality of speech signals under a wide range of distortions. It is inherently connected to speech enhancement (SE), which seeks to improve speech quality by removing unwanted signal components. While SQA models are widely used to evaluate SE performance, their potential to guide SE training remains underexplored.

arxiv-2507-13712.title: LLaPipe: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Automated Data Preparation Pipeline Construction
arxiv-2507-13712.creator: Jing Chang 2350273007@email.szu.edu.cn Chang Liu 2300271084@email.szu.edu.cn Jinbin Huang jbhuang@comp.hkbu.edu.hk Rui Mao mao@szu.edu.cn, Jianbin Qin qinjianbin@szu.edu.cn College of Computer Science and Software Engineering, Shenzhen UniversitySchool of Artificial Intelligence, Shenzhen University
arxiv-2507-13712.description: Abstract Automated data preparation is crucial for democratizing machine learning, yet existing reinforcement learning (RL) based approaches suffer from inefficient exploration in the vast space of possible preprocessing pipelines. We present LLaPipe, a novel framework that addresses this exploration bottleneck by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) as intelligent policy advisors.

pmc-11351680.title: Enhanced Soil Fertility and Carbon Sequestration in Urban Green Spaces through the Application of Fe-Modified Biochar Combined with Plant Growth-Promoting Bacteria
pmc-11351680.creator: Guoyao Niu, Chiquan He, Shaohua Mao, Zongze Chen, Yangyang Ma, Yi Zhu, Maria Amélia Martins-Loução
pmc-11351680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryThis study investigated the effects of plant growth promoting bacteria (Bacillus clausii) and Fe-modified biochar on soil fertility increases and mechanisms of carbon sequestration. Additionally, the impact on C-cycling-related enzyme activity and the bacterial community was also explored.

pmc-11438165.title: Effectiveness and safety of rivaroxaban or low-molecular-weight heparin in non-major orthopedic surgery: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-11438165.creator: Lemei Zhu, Bohua Zhu, Pingping Bing, Mingxu Qi, Binsheng He
pmc-11438165.description: BackgroundPatients undergoing non-major orthopedic surgery often face an increased risk of venous thromboembolism due to the necessity of immobilization postoperatively. Current guidelines commonly recommend the use of low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) for prophylaxis, but it is associated with low patient compliance and certain side effects.

pmc-11704314.title: Hemi-Gastrocnemius Hemi-Soleus Bi-pedicled Muscle Flap and Bone Transport in Reconstruction of Bone and Soft Tissue Defects in an Open Fracture Tibia Gustilo Type IIIc
pmc-11704314.creator: Mohammad A Ali, Mohammed A Sanad, Mohamed O Elhassan, Khalid Alawadi
pmc-11704314.description: Soft tissue injury in open fracture of the lower extremity represents a challenging trauma that requires complex strategies to reconstruct both bony and soft tissue defects. Various options are available to cover the soft tissue defect in the lower extremities, from simple skin grafting to local fasciocutaneous and muscle flaps.

pmc-11812510.title: Trial sequential analysis: Quality improvement for meta-analysis
pmc-11812510.creator: Indubala Maurya, Ayush Lohiya, Ashish Solanki
pmc-11812510.description: lysis (TSA).[14141719] Two out of five TSAs confirmed the results of meta-analyses, and the required sample size was reached in these two meta-analyses. These TSAs suggest that the result is definitive and that other randomised controlled trials are unlikely to modify the effect on the outcomes.

pmc-12460174.title: The evolution of hominin bipedalism in two steps
pmc-12460174.creator: Gayani Senevirathne, Serena C Fernandopulle, Daniel Richard, Stephanie L Baumgart, Anika Liv Christensen, Matteo Fabbri, Jakob Höppner, Harald Jüppner, Peishu Li, Vivien Bothe, Nadia Fröbisch, Ian Simcock, Owen J Arthurs, Alistair Calder, Naomi Freilich, Niamh C Nowlan, Ian A Glass, April Craft, Ter
pmc-12460174.description: Bipedalism is a human-defining trait1–3. It is made possible by the familiar, bowl-shaped pelvis, whose short, wide iliac blades curve along the sides of the body to stabilize walking and support internal organs and a large-brained, broad-shouldered baby4–6. The ilium changes compared with living primates are an evolutionary novelty7. However, how this evolution came about remains unknown.

pmc-12558732.title: Advances in artificial intelligence applications for the management of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
pmc-12558732.creator: Mingyu Wang, Luhan Li, Min Feng, Zhuo Liu
pmc-12558732.description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), characterized by high incidence and mortality rates, is a chronic respiratory disorder that places a substantial burden on healthcare systems. Artificial Intelligence (AI), with its deep integration into the medical field, particularly through its core branches—Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL)—has demonstrated significant potential in the intervention and management of COPD.

pmc-12691727.title: Relationship Satisfaction and Body Image-Related Quality of Life as Correlates of Sexual Function During Pregnancy: A Systematic Review
pmc-12691727.creator: Razvan-Ionut Daniluc, Marius Craina, Alina Andreea Tischer, Andrei-Cristian Bondar, Lavinia Stelea, Mihai Calin Bica, Loredana Stana, Daniele Giansanti
pmc-12691727.description: Background and Objectives: Sexual function often fluctuates during pregnancy, yet the contributions of body image-related quality of life (BI-QoL)—operationalized via body image instruments such as the Body Exposure during Sexual Activities Questionnaire (BESAQ) and pregnancy-specific body image scales—and relationship satisfaction remain inconsistently quantified.

pmc-13092992.title: Which aspects of anhedonia predict response to pharmacotherapy in major depressive disorder?
pmc-13092992.creator: Rudolf Uher, Sakina J Rizvi, Lena C Quilty, Barbara Pavlova, Abraham Nunes, Jane A Foster, Raymond W Lam, Roumen Milev, Daniel J Müller, Valerie Taylor, Claudio N Soares, Susan Rotzinger, Sidney H Kennedy, Benicio N Frey
pmc-13092992.description: BackgroundAnhedonia is a multidimensional concept, and it is not known which aspects of it are linked to the heterogeneity of treatment responses in major depressive disorder (MDD). We examine the role of anhedonia dimensions in predicting response to antidepressant medication and adjunctive pharmacotherapy.

pmc-13121148.title: Integrating clinical and multiomics evidence based on disease module theory: deciphering the comorbidity network of psoriasis vulgaris via the Ising model for mechanistic insights
pmc-13121148.creator: Dongwen Shi, Yuan Luo, Ping Zhang, Bin Liang, Mengmeng Wang, Hong Cai, Xiaowen Pang
pmc-13121148.description: Psoriasis vulgaris (PV), a chronic immune-mediated inflammatory dermatosis, is associated with a significant burden of systemic comorbidities. Traditional comorbidity research methods struggle to reveal its complex interconnectedness. Based on large-scale retrospective cohort data, we constructed a PV comorbidity network using the Ising model from statistical physics.

pmc-13471537.title: Efficacy of perineal massage in second stage of labour for prevention of perineal trauma: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13471537.creator: Kritika Gupta, Shikha Chadha, Sandhya Jain, Hima C. Kille, Baba Saheb Ambedkar
pmc-13471537.description: BackgroundHigh-quality intra-partum care is crucial for all expectant mothers to ensure safe delivery and favourable postpartum recovery. Vaginal delivery when associated with perineal trauma makes postpartum period painful and increases risk of long-term morbidity. Perineal trauma has been reported to be more common among Asian women. Interventions which minimise the perineal trauma will enhance the experience of motherhood.

pmc-13503838.title: Learning-driven multi-timescale operation simulation and hierarchical boundary optimization for renewable-dominated energy systems under temporal and scenario uncertainties
pmc-13503838.creator: Qian Ma, Jin Zou, He Huang, Jinbing Liang, Siyu Lu, Jialu Li, Qiang Zhang
pmc-13503838.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This paper addresses the challenge of coordinating power system operation across multiple temporal horizons under high renewable penetration and scenario uncertainty, where conventional decoupled scheduling frameworks fail to maintain operational consistency and adaptability. To overcome this limitation, we propose a learning-driven multi-timescale operation simulation and hierarchical boundary optimization framework that integrates deep sequence forecasting, reinforcement learning, and rolling model predictive control within a unified optimization structure.
